code: terminator = ProcessSsmlTag(xml_buf, buf, &ix, n_buf, xmlbase, &audio_text, voice_change, &base_voice, base_voice_variant_name, &ignore_text, &clear_skipping_text, &sayas_mode, &sayas_start, ssml_stack, &n_ssml_stack, &n_param_stack, (int *)speech_parameters);
note: The input is parsed as SSML and forwarded into tag processing.
The xml:base attribute is copied into a fixed-size local buffer.
The copied xml:base string is stored and later reused as a base path; the safety obligation is that the stored base path remains a valid, bounded string for later concatenation.
A long xml:base combined with a long audio src can overflow the 256-byte fname buffer during path construction.
